title: Murray Gell-Mann talks about Richard Feynman
summary: In a short interview clip, physicist Murray Gell-Mann talks about working alongside Richard Feynman at Caltech. He describes how the two men clashed in personality and image despite similar brilliance.
why: HN commenters cite it for Gell-Mann's candid and not always flattering view of Feynman's showmanship and character.
